title: SimulatedCommand V1 (existing legacy Worker wire)
description: Existing six-field format consumed by betting-worker JsonCommandDecoder. This is NOT AcademicCommand: SUSPEND_BETS/RESUME_BETS use the separate academic-command-v1 schema and listener. No integrated production publisher for this legacy wire is demonstrated; fixtures prove decoder compatibility only. This schema neither enables acceptance nor supplies authority, grants or leases. Enable date-time format assertions.
$comment: JSON Schema integer is mathematical: 1.0 also validates as integer, while the existing Jackson decoder requires an integral JSON token. Duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8 and trailing tokens must be rejected by the codec before schema validation; schemas cannot enforce those lexical constraints.
